HOW to repair you skin barrier and not make it even worse if you have OILY SKIN? 👇🏻 your skincare routine while healing your barrier:  ☀️: gentle cleanser + hydrating serum + barrier moisturizer + spf 🌙: micellar water/ oil or milk cleanser + cleanser + hydrating serum + barrier moisturizer  and please, STOP drying out your skin to make it less oily, instead do this:  1. if you’re extremely oily in the morning, use gentle cleanser. which one? look for something with rice, hyaluronic acid or ceramides  2. NEVER skip moisturizer! this is a MUST and you need moisturizer that will support your oily skin (and no, aestura’s cream won’t help you, it is for dry skin girlies, and you need something gel-based) look for ceramides, panthenol/B5, squalane or glycerine in your moisturizer and opt for gel-based products  3. humectants every single time you apply skincare. get yourself hyaluronic acid or beta-glucan serum and it will save your skin in a week, trust me  4. lightweight sunscreen every morning. you won’t  repair your skin barrier if you skip spf.. i’m being for real, so find yourself water-based or airy sunscreen (like beauty of joseon’s aqua fresh spf, or tocobo’s water gel sun cream) 5. zinc PCA or niacinamide. these two control oil production, so if you find skincare infused with any of these ingredients – GORGEOUS (but make sure to use low niacinamide concentrations, like 2-4% max)  6. pause actives. no retinoids will help you if your skin barrier is weak and damaged. first we heal our barrier, then we use any actives we need  subscribe, my page is all about making your oily skin look gorgeous and glowy 🤭✨ #oilyskin #skinbarrier #clearskin #skincaretips #oilyskintips
